sample_description: single isolated anodic TiO2 nanotube (Ti foil anodized 60 V 5 h in ethylene glycol/NH4F/H2O, ~120 nm diameter), annealed to polycrystalline anatase, transferred onto SiNx(150 nm)/p-Si substrate with Cr/Au contacts; crystallite size ~8 nm (from the Eg shift)
conditions: annealed in air by rapid thermal annealing (350 °C or 450 °C used in the study; text compares this tube with ~350 °C); laser power ~3 mW
notes: paper: Eg (blueshift from phonon confinement; Raman map of this band in Fig. 1e inset); PDF used is the arXiv preprint 1702.07586; bulk values 144/197/399/513/519/639 quoted from Ohsaka skipped; Si substrate line labelled in Fig. 1e has no number (not extracted)
